output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS discontinued_net_revenue
FROM marts.fct_order_lines l
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND p.is_active = false;
output.explanation: Discontinued products are taken as products with is_active = false in dim_products. Revenue follows the warehouse definition: only orders flagged is_revenue = true count. Order lines from those orders are joined to their products, and net_amount is summed over the whole period with no date filter. The result is a single total rounded to 2 decimals. The query has not been run, so the figure is unverified.
